changes.text: 📦 4.10 LIVE data refresh (build 12568521). Parser added two new per-damage-type fields to damageResistancePools — damageCap (hard cap on damage per hit, applied independently of the multiplier) and damageCapLimit (currently 0 everywhere, semantics unclear so we hold off on displaying it until it starts carrying values). At 4.10 exactly one pool actually uses damageCap: the BUL-H4 family (Armor, Helmet, and their Snow Camo variants) get 45 for most damage types and 10 for biochemical. Every other armor still has 0 across the board.

🛡 Fabricator Armor Stats picks up a new 'Damage Cap' section under the Damage Resistance grid — only shows when at least one damage type carries a non-zero cap. For the BUL-H4 items this now surfaces the 45-per-hit ceiling that was invisible before; the other 15 armor records render exactly as they did.

🩹 Patch Delta view no longer prints '[object Object]' when a comparison touches damageResistance. A dedicated per-type renderer now shows the actual multiplier and cap changes side-by-side (e.g. 'Physical Resist: ×0.10 → ×0.13'), matching the pattern the ammo-diff renderer already followed. Existing multiplier-only deltas keep rendering the same way.

🩹 Mission detail's Combat tab was crashing to a black screen on any mission with an Ace Pilot encounter (Headhunters and similar). The translation-hook rollout from 1.0.45 wrapped the encounter ⚠ ACE badge in a loc() call inside a sub-component that hadn't been given access to the localizer. Prop passed through, tab renders again — thanks DarkRod, smileygladhand, Cove for the reports.

📦 4.10 LIVE data refresh (build 12545750) — bundle of parser-side fixes: Carinite (Pure) name corrected from the previous 'Carinitepure' artifact and its quality bands filled in (was empty before), and three Aztalan Legs blueprints picked up a hedged data-issue annotation on their Segment Paneling / armor_damagemitigation modifier (modifierAtStart appears to be 9.0 where 0.9 would match the rest of the Aztalan family — likely a decimal-point drift on CIG's side, we surface it without asserting it).

⚠ Data-issue markers reach the Fabricator recipe view. The parser publishes per-blueprint annotations in a side-channel; the Fabricator now consumes them and shows a ⚠ next to the affected recipe name in the list and detail views, plus a second ⚠ on the exact modifier row inside the recipe so it's obvious which value we're flagging. Tooltip carries the parser's hedged note — 'appears intended to be…', never a direct claim.

🌐 Community-translation scaffolding — added ~60 localization hooks around badge labels, Fabricator panel headers, and tooltips that previously lived as English JSX literals. Zero visible change under the default English render (fallback = current wording), but the strings are now reachable for the community lang file when the parser-side translation base + a translated set (e.g. Walker's zh-CN work) land. Also switched several data-direct labels (manufacturer, fire mode, range category) to the same name-based lookup that already handles slot names.

📦 4.10.0 goes LIVE (build 12519617). The previous LIVE snapshot (4.9.0-live.12344265) and the last PTU snapshot (4.10.0-ptu.12504217) have both been purged — SCMDB now serves 4.10 LIVE exclusively until the next PTU cycle opens.

🔧 4.10 Ore Pods + Mining Consumables — the 10 items that shipped with placeholder data now carry proper stats parser-side (Ore Pods: cargoCapacitySCU + health; Mining Consumables: charges + modifier-set with the same keys as mining_equipment lasers). Fabricator surfaces them: Ore Pod BPs show Cargo Capacity under Product Stats; Mining Module BPs show Charges + each modifier as its own stat row (Optimal Charge Window, Instability, Resistance, Shatter Damage, Overcharge Rate, …). Both product families also get their own filter chip under Ship Components (📦 Ore Pod, 💠 Mining Module) so they're findable from the sidebar.

🔧 /docs/*.md links from the profile now open the raw markdown file again instead of loading the app shell (which then rendered 'No game data versions could be loaded' because it thought it was on a non-app route). Service-Worker denylist extended to /docs/ — same pattern as the earlier /downloads/ fix.
📦 Updated to 4.10.0 PTU (build 12442953).

🌐 LIVE re-parse (4.9.0-live.12344265) — restores the required-intro title on 12 Adaigo salvage-chain contracts. Consumers of the Adaigo intro missions now show 'Claim #[CLAIM]: [SHIP] Salvage Rights' on their Requirements badge instead of an empty box.

🌐 Mission detail: 'In-game also shown as' section + the variant-picker (both the current-viewing entry and sibling links) now run through the community translation. Previously these lines stayed English regardless of active language — Russian translator reported it. Same-modal Required-intro badge got a defensive fallback so a title-less parser reference at least shows the mission's debug name instead of an empty badge.

🔍 Fabricator search now also matches community-translated names. With a language file loaded, a recipe can be found by its translated product or material name (e.g. Chinese) — previously Fab search only matched the English fields, so a translated query returned nothing. Missions already worked this way.

🌐 Contracts now show a data-issue marker when the source data appears to file them under the wrong faction. The contract still appears under the faction its data actually references (nothing is silently moved); a ⚠ badge with a tooltip notes the likely intended faction. First cases: three "Red Wind Straightforward Cargo Recovery" (Medium) contracts on PTU and LIVE that reference Citizens For Prosperity but appear intended for Red Wind Linehaul.

🔧 Community translation now reaches the Fabricator: crafting recipe ingredient and product names are translated via the loaded language file where a matching entry exists (looked up by English name). Untranslated names stay in English.

📱 Mobile: the Watcher indicator is hidden on phones — it drives a desktop companion that doesn't apply on mobile. Detection combines viewport size and user agent, so a desktop browser in a narrow window keeps it.
📱 Mobile: the LIVE/PTU channel switch is now in the mobile page menu.
📱 Mobile: the mission-title column in Table view no longer collapses to a few pixels — it keeps enough width to read the start of each name.
📦 Updated to 4.10.0 PTU (build 12409360).
📦 Updated to 4.10.0 PTU (build 12399239).
📦 Updated to 4.10.0 PTU (build 12388491).

🔧 Crafting recipes: 10 vehicle weapons were listed as "ballistic" even though their weapon type is different — MaxOx NN- and NDB-series Neutron weapons (now neutron), the Banu Singe Cannon (tachyon), and the Thlilye Laser Gatling (laser). Corrected in both channels; filtering crafting recipes by weapon type now lists them under the right category.

📦 Updated to 4.10.0 PTU (build 12344240).

🔧 Blueprint-progress column and tile display now stay populated on PTU — they show your LIVE-owned blueprints joined against the PTU mission's pool as reference. Dimmed styling + (LIVE) label + tooltip make clear it's cross-channel info; PTU progress still doesn't persist and marking blueprints owned still requires being on LIVE. Fixes the 'BP columns look empty on PTU' report — they were correctly gated but the silent gate read as a bug.

⛏ Mining Signature Identifier: the highlight / match-list box now has a collapse toggle (▾/▸) in its header. Collapsed it shrinks to a single header line ('N highlighted' / 'N matches') so a long list can't visually overlap the scan-results chart underneath. Setting persists per browser.
📦 Updated to 4.10.0 PTU (build 12335477).
📦 Updated to 4.10.0 PTU (build 12326622).

🔍 'Filter by pool' now resets other mission filters. Clicking the button from the Fabricator, Catalog or a blueprint-detail overlay used to keep any previously-set Reward Scope / System / Legality / Sharing filters active alongside the pool — so a user with prior filters would frequently see an empty result. The pool is now the sole active facet after the jump, matching the intent 'show me every mission in this pool'. Thanks to DarkRod for the repro.
📦 Updated to 4.9.0 LIVE (build 12302499).
📦 4.10.0 PTU (build 12311913) — the 4.10 PTU cycle is now trackable in SCMDB. Switch via the LIVE/PTU toggle in the header.

🔍 Share filter view — a '🔗 Share' button next to Clear-all in the sidebar copies a link that restores the current filter state (search, chips, ranges, blueprint pool, cargo sliders, etc.) for whoever opens it. Recipient sees a banner listing the incoming filters and picks Apply or Discard — no silent overwrite of their own filter. Also covers the 'share this blueprint pool' use-case that surfaced from a request: the BP-pool filter is one of the encoded fields.

🎁 Table view: opt-in 'Scrip' column under Rewards — shows the reward amount plus the type (Council or MG Scrip) for the ~200 missions that award scrip. Sortable and bucketed by type: DESC-top shows all MG Scrip missions from highest to lowest amount, then all Council Scrip, then the rest. For the Wikelo-favor-grind use-case.

⚡ PTU-fallback: users who happened to be on the PTU channel when an admin flipped PTU off could stay stranded on PTU indefinitely because the static CDN cache of the site-settings file only refreshes periodically. useSiteSettings now cross-checks Supabase when the CDN file's own updated_at is older than 30 minutes, so a real admin toggle propagates within one page-load rather than several hours. Also side-fixes the reported 'BP-progress bars disappeared in Tile view' — same root cause, since the PTU channel intentionally hides blueprint / tracking overlays.

🔧 Fabricator: material-quality chip clarified — the '(min 1)' hint next to a '0.5 SCU' material was easy to misread as 'minimum 1 SCU'. Now spelled out as '(min quality N)' with a dotted underline and help cursor advertising the tooltip; the chip only appears when the recipe actually imposes a quality floor (>0), removing ~2/3 of previously-noisy '(min quality 0)' rows.

🔧 Fabricator: material-quality slider now covers the recipe's full acceptance range (0-1000 for most raw materials), not just the modifier's data-defined window. Quality below the modifier's start produces the flat baseline value instead of the slider being hard-capped — matches the recipe reality that low-quality material is craftable, just doesn't add the bonus. Also brings the 'Min' preset and the manual slider into agreement.

🚀 Salvage Rights missions now list their target-ship pool again in the mission detail. A parser regression during the 4.9.0-live cycle had silently dropped the SalvageSpawnDescription pool resolution on 30 contracts across the Adagio, Adaigo and RR_Pyro salvage families; the intro / very-easy variants also correctly resolve to the single-Aegis-Gladius pool again. Three new Battaglia salvage contracts introduced in 4.9.0 that had never had ship-pool data now have it too. Fixed parser-side; current LIVE data files re-generated in place (no build-number bump). Thanks to RedAnxiety for spotting it.
📦 Updated to 4.9.0 LIVE (build 12269732).

🎁 Table view: two opt-in scope columns in their own '⚙ → Scope' section — 'Accept Scope' (reputation scope required to accept the mission) and 'Reward Scope' (the scope(s) actually paid out on completion). Multi-scope missions show the primary with '(+N)' and list the rest in the tooltip. Makes the ~5% of contracts where accept-scope ≠ reward-scope (e.g. 'Cargo Retrieval' requires Standing but pays Hauling) visible at a glance without opening each mission's Calculator tab.

🐛 Blueprint-Ownership-Verlust bei Log-Watcher-Backlog-Replay behoben — wenn SCMDB geöffnet wurde während Star Citizen + Watcher bereits liefen, konnte der replay-Burst der 'blueprint_received'-Events das Supabase-Profil-Fetch überholen und die owned-Blueprints der Nutzerin auf die Handvoll gerade eingespielten Tags reduzieren. Bulk-Writes laufen jetzt über eine server-side Union-RPC (kein Client-Snapshot mehr im Write-Pfad) und werden zusätzlich gepuffert bis das Profil geladen ist. Missionstracking hatte denselben latenten Bug im gleichen Codepfad, ist mitgefixt.

🔍 Table view: opt-in 'Debug Name'-Spalte — zeigt den parser-emittierten internen Contract-Identifier. Wenn mehrere SubContract-Varianten zu einem Row gemerged wurden (gleiche Pools, unterschiedliche Anchors), erscheint '(+N)' hinter dem primären Namen und der Tooltip listet alle Varianten auf. Aktivierbar im ⚙-Column-Picker, default off.
📦 Updated to 4.9.0 LIVE (build 12248363).

📦 Cargo (Hauling) filter block — Total SCU range plus Max Container (1/2/4/8/16/24/32), Max Pickups and Max Dropoffs sliders. Sidebar section sits between Tracking and Events; any control moved off default scopes results to hauling missions. Three opt-in table columns (SCU · Box, Pickups, Dropoffs) via the ⚙ column picker — sortable, use the same numbers as the filter.

⛏ Signature Identifier: standalone page — the mineral-scan identifier is now deep-linkable via `?sig=<raw>` and openable in its own tab from the Mining page or the SigChart modal. Handy for sharing a specific scan without pulling the recipient through the whole Mining UI.
⛏ Mining SigChart pill readability — mineral labels now sit on an opaque background so the underlying span line no longer cuts through the text.
📦 Updated to 4.9.0 LIVE (build 12232306). PTU snapshot promoted; all mission, blueprint and mining data now reflects the live patch.

📡 Offline support — SCMDB now installs as a Progressive Web App and keeps working when your connection blips. Mission browsing, Fabricator recipes, Mining Solver and Patch Delta all work from cached data. Header 'OFFLINE' badge appears when the backend is unreachable; write actions like voting disable themselves rather than sit spinning. When new patch data drops while you're offline, a reload banner appears once you reconnect.

📡 Log Watcher v0.1.9 — backlog replay. If SCMDB is opened while a Star Citizen session is already running, the watcher now replays events it saw before the browser connected (up to 500) so completed missions and received blueprints aren't lost. Frontend suppresses timer/modal side-effects on replay so you don't get flooded with dialogs for missions from earlier in the session. Older watcher versions (0.1.6-0.1.8) still work — replay is additive.

🌐 Prerequisite Missions — the mission Requirements tab now resolves the internal completedContractTags GUIDs into human-readable lists (e.g. 'Complete any of: Journeyman Tracker License Certification, Reclusive Bounty · Nyx · Pyro · Stanton'). Covers ~700 contracts per channel where the requirement was previously invisible. Certification-style awarders float to the top, per-system regional duplicates collapse into one entry with a system tail.

⛏ Mining Solver: math trace — a new 'Show math' button opens a modal walking through rock blending, loadout modifier stack, effective rock stats and yield calculation step by step. Formulas are informed by community research (Mort13, Evergr3n, Oshida). Explicitly not game-canon; this is our best-guess model and clearly marked as such.

⛏ Mining Solver: current / updated stacking-model toggle — switch between additive stacking (the original SCMDB model) and multiplicative stacking (community-observed in-game behaviour). Lives in the solver header; math trace re-renders per selected model so both worldviews are inspectable side by side.

🔧 Fabricator: clickable material names — click any ore or mineral in a recipe (Lindinium, Beryl, Ouratite, …) or in the dismantle result list to jump straight to the Resources page pre-filtered on that material. Middle-click opens in a new tab. Also works for hand-mined crystals (Aphorite, Hadanite, Sadaryx). Deep-link URL: `?page=mine&r=NAME`.

💎 Item knownIssue annotations — items in the catalog flagged by a community source as broken or suspected-broken now carry a per-item note visible in the pool view, blueprint detail and disassemble output. Uses the same hedged language as elsewhere ('possible data inconsistency', not 'CIG bug').

🎁 Scope divergence surfaced on the ~5% of missions where the standing-required-to-accept lives on a different scope than the standing-rewarded. Side-by-side accept-scope and reward-scope rank ladders on the Calculator tab so the two aren't confused; explanatory note on the Requirements tab.

🎁 Base XP column: dedupes cross-scope reward rows (contracts that grant XP to both a faction reputation AND a standing scope no longer double-count) and now surfaces event points as the Base XP value for event-only contracts.

🌐 Alternate mission titles — when the parser merges two subcontracts that share pools but had different in-game titles, both titles now show in the detail modal so you can match what the game showed you.

📱 Adaptive header — a stricter effective-width check gates compact-mode layout, so browsers with sidebars or narrow window widths hit the compact layout at the right threshold without leaving the header cramped.

🔍 Item Catalog: pool headers now show a rank-range chip (which ranks spawn this pool) and a system chip (Stanton / Pyro / Nyx / Multi). Helps answer 'what does this pool spawn in Pyro at Sr. Tracker rank?' without opening each mission.
🔧 Fabricator: Blueprint detail opens as a global overlay from the cart panel — click a cart entry to inspect its recipe without leaving whatever page you were on.
🔧 Fabricator: craft-time toggle — switch between raw seconds (spreadsheet-friendly) and m:ss / h:mm:ss (planning-friendly) via a small chip in the craft-time area. Setting persists across sessions.
⛏ Mining: Signature Identifier default-selects the minerals present at the currently-selected location, one click faster on first identification.

⛏ Mining Solver: gadget resistance and instability now visible in the Scan Results panel. The underlying math has always applied gadgets correctly, but the display was showing only the equipment side of the stack — reading 0.87 → 0.20 for a Sabir-equipped Prospector when the true effective was 0.10. Trace now walks through the two-stage rock × gadget × equipment chain.

⛏ Mining Solver: multiplicative-model math corrected — window and charge-rate gadget modifiers now chain through as a proper trailing factor instead of being additively tacked onto the already-multiplicative equipment stack. Only affects users on the 'updated model' toggle; additive model unchanged.

⛏ Mining Solver: dropped the 'Window size capped at +50%' annotation from the Laser Stats bar — the +% modifier itself isn't capped, only the final rendered green zone is (90° of the 180° meter arc = 0.5 of the charge bar). Trace prose updated to match.

⛏ Mining Solver: Resistance labels clarified. Scan Results shows effective resistance including active modules ('with actives'); FeasibilityPanel shows the passive-only baseline used for DPS-range calculation. Same value in different reference frames — labels now say which is which.

🚨 Battaglia (and any faction whose parser-emitted rank ladder is missing higher tiers): the Calculator's rank table no longer mis-badges an out-of-ladder MAX as the top local rank. Verbal 'Mission unavailable above X' note still surfaces the requirement.

🧮 Calculator: non-shareable contracts now coerce to Solo — the Multicrew toggle is disabled with a tooltip, and stale multicrew state from a previously-viewed shareable mission can no longer leak into the rep/UEC math.
🎁 Reward column sort: buy-in cost is now factored into the sort key so buy-in-only contracts sort meaningfully. Previously they clustered as if their reward was zero.
🗄 Mission table: virtual scroll no longer locks at 5 rows after a search that returned no results and then got cleared.
📦 Updated to 4.8.2 LIVE (build 12030094).
📡 Log Watcher v0.1.8 — minor tweaks + refreshed README. v0.1.6 and v0.1.7 still work, no forced update.

🧹 Header decluttered at 1080p — UI Scale, Columns slider and ★ MEMA toggle moved into the ⚙ Settings popover. View toggle (Tiles/Table) stays inline. Addresses the 'header cramped' report from 16:9 1080p users.

📥 Watcher Import: conflict resolver for ambiguous blueprint names — when a log entry doesn't map cleanly to one catalogue BP (substring match with multiple candidates, or zero matches due to community string mods like Kraken's StarStrings), the import dialog now shows a per-row picker with best-guess and Skip options. Mass-apply and Skip-all buttons for batches. No more 'last wins' when multiple conflicts exist.

⚒ Fabricator: slider-mode toggle (Free / Snap) visually separated from the Quality Presets row — labelled 'Slider mode:' with its own pill style, so it's no longer overlooked as a fifth preset button.

⚒ Fabricator compare-view crash — comparing M3A / M4A / M5A / M6A laser cannons threw a TypeError because some weapons have a fireModes[0] wrapper without a top-level fireRate. Compare table now shows '—' for the cell instead of crashing the whole modal.

⚒ Fabricator 'Clear all' filters: Size slider, the Owned / Not-owned / Blacklist tri-state and the Blacklist filter chip were not being reset. They're now included in the reset routine like the other filters.

📊 Calculator: refueling missions with 250 base XP were showing only 50. Cause: contracts can emit multiple factionRewards rows for the same faction (e.g. base XP + completion bonus), and the calculator was reading only the first row. Now sums all matching-faction rows.
📦 Updated to 4.8.1 LIVE (build 11952564).

🚨 Mission Bug Reports — community 👍 / 👎 vote on each mission, from the Community tab of the detail modal. A coloured health dot in every mission card and a sortable Health column in the table summarise the crowd-source state (🟢 healthy / 🟡 minor issues / 🟠 problematic / 🔴 broken). Reason dropdown covers the common SC mission bugs: Stuck, Mission completed but doesn't finish, Mission never offered despite meeting prereqs, Cargo / freight elevator broken, Marker wrong or missing, and more. Patch-aware — counts reset at every Y.Z bump. Aggregated counts refresh 1–2× daily; your own click reflects instantly.

🚨 Filter: 'Hide community-flagged missions' dropdown — pick the threshold (broken only / broken + problematic / everything except healthy). Missions with no votes yet (grey dot) are always shown so first-time voters can still find them and surface them for others.

📋 Column picker for the mission table — click the ⚙ icon in the table toolbar to opt extra columns in or out. New columns include Category, Min/Max Rank, Shareable, Cooldown, Chain, Since (introduced-in patch), Active Event, Cargo, and the new Health column. Selection persists per browser; defaults match the previous layout so nothing changes unless you opt in.

🌐 Pool slot disambiguation — when an availability pool contains multiple slots that resolve to the same display name (e.g. three 'Cinch Scraper Module' entries in a single pool), each one now carries a tag-derived suffix in the slot list so you can tell which roll picks which entry. Previously the pool view collapsed them into a single line.

⚒ Fabricator: visual highlighting for the dismantle blacklist materials plus a tri-state filter chip. Recipes that produce one of the eight non-returnable materials are now visibly marked, and the chip lets you carve them in or out of the BP list. Builds on the dismantle blacklist banner introduced in 1.0.13.
📏 Header: compact layout at 1080p — VER label dropped, nav buttons tightened, subtitle threshold raised. Prevents header crowding on common laptop widths.

📱 Mining: signature chart collapsible on phone viewports — auto-collapsed below 900 px width, manual toggle button between the chart and the match list. Frees vertical space on small screens where the match list is the primary surface anyway.
📦 Updated to 4.8.1 LIVE (build 11875683).

📡 Sync Sinks (preview) — opt-in outbound mirror to user-configured endpoints. Lets orgs and third-party tools consume your tracked missions, blueprints and profile in their own dashboard. LIVE / HOTFIX events only — PTU/EPTU/Tech-Preview never leaves the browser. Wire-format documented at /docs/sync-sinks.md.
📡 Sync Sinks: per-sink Resync button + auto-resync on edit / clear / reopen, so downstream consumers stay consistent without manual snapshot triggers.

🔍 Tri-state filter chips across Missions, Mining and Fabricator pages — every filter chip now cycles None → Include → Exclude → None. Right-click jumps straight to Exclude. Lets you carve out 'everything except X' without juggling include-only sets.

🔍 'Released since/in' filter — pick a baseline patch (e.g. 'since 4.8.0') and the list narrows to missions that first appeared at or after that version. Missions appearing for the first time also get a NEW badge in the tile and table views. Built on a parser-generated patch-history index.
🔍 Cargo-mission filter + debug-name search — narrow by whether a mission carries cargo manifests, and search by the CIG debugName (e.g. RR_CRU_*) in addition to the localized title.

⚡ Active in-game events indicator — when a scenario is currently enabled in the loaded data, a pill in the stats bar shows '⚡ N events active'. Click it for a popover listing each active event (with the count of gated missions) plus a one-click filter to show all event-gated missions at once. Pill stays hidden when nothing is active.

🔍 'Released since' dropdown now annotates each version with the count of newly-added missions — '4.8.0 (174 new)', '4.8.1 (current patch — no new missions)' — so version-only patch bumps are visible before clicking.

🔍 Zero-add patch hint — when the picked 'Released since' version added no missions, the mission list shows an explanation that previously-inactive missions may have been enabled by an event activation, plus a one-click jump to the Event category filter.

🔍 Reward-Scope dropdown: when two scopes share the same in-game label (e.g. 'Bounty Hunting' exists for both Northrock Service Group and Bounty Hunters Guild), the faction is now appended in parens to disambiguate. Was previously showing two identical 'Bounty Hunting' rows.

🌐 SubContract families collapsed into one card — when CIG diversifies a single mission template into per-station variants (e.g. 29 'QV Breaker Station Mining Rights' contracts that are byte-identical apart from the station name), they're now grouped under a single card. The variant count is shown as a tag; the detail modal lists every station.

🌐 Mission scope labels use the in-game displayName — internal CIG identifiers like 'BountyHunter' or 'FactionReputation' now resolve to their localized labels ('Bounty Hunting' / 'Standing'). The raw scopeNames are kept as internal filter values.

🔧 Blueprint progress: pool-level multi-pool explanation — when a mission's blueprints come from more than one pool, the detail modal now explains the drop mechanics inline (which pool a blueprint comes from, and what 'one per pool per run' means in practice).

🔧 Blueprint progress: record-based deduplication — the BP-progress count is now computed off the parser's blueprintRecord GUID (1:1 with each item), not the product name. Fixes counts where two items in a pool happened to share a product name (5× BroadSpec-Go, 3× Defiant, 2× QuadraCell MX). Also makes the ✓/☐ toggle hit the correct row on every duplicate.

🔧 Blueprint quick-preview — click a blueprint in the detail modal to see its base stats, slot composition and a direct Fabricator link without leaving the mission. Chain mission links also open in a new tab via middle/right-click now.

🎁 Item reward delivery flags — the Overview tab now annotates whether each item reward is delivered to your inventory, to your hangar, applied as a vehicle component, etc. Previously this lived only in parser-emitted data.
🌐 'Random' chip removed from deterministic reward bundles — was misleadingly applied to rewards that were actually fixed sets.
🚀 Combat encounters: hostile beats friendly in compound encounter roles. ShipHeist targets are correctly classified as neutral, not friendly.

⛏ Mining locations: CRU-L3 added to the Lagrange C survey; Terminus Ring synthesised as a Pyro mining location; HUR-L2 Faithful Dream refinery added in Stanton. Aaron Halo entries now link to the 'All Mining Base locations' survey chip.
⛏ Mining Solver: extraction multipliers from gadget modules (Vaux et al.) now apply to the solver physics. Previously the modules were displayed but their effect was silently dropped.
⛏ Mining Solver: opening the laser-craft modal no longer crashes (was a temporal-dead-zone error on the equipment state).

⛏ Mining: route screen sub-element percentages corrected; Glaciem Ring gets a hint about its observed yield distribution. Decay and cracking rates reverted from a broken /pcpm normalisation that had produced incorrect optimal-power values.
⛏ Mining: modelled-zero quality bands are now drawn explicitly instead of silently omitted, so the band axis stays consistent across elements.

⚒ Fabricator: distortion-damage weapons (Suckerpunch family) now show their real per-shot damage. Previously they reported ~0 because the parser exposed only the near-zero impact damage; the detonation payload is now picked up automatically when impact damage is functionally zero. The row label reads 'Distortion Damage / Shot (detonation)' so the source is clear.

⚒ Fabricator: ship weapons show computed range (projectile speed × lifetime) instead of CIG's combatRange field — the CIG values were FPS-leaning defaults ('Medium 30-50 m' even for cannons that reach ~1800 m in-game). FPS weapons keep the category label.

⚒ Fabricator: magazine tag hidden for ship energy / distortion weapons — those draw from the ship's capacitor, not a per-weapon magazine, so 'Mag: 0' was misleading. Ballistic ship weapons and personal weapons still show their magazine size.
⚒ Fabricator: mission links open in a new tab via middle/right-click — matches the rest of the app.

⚒ Fabricator: dismantle blacklist — a banner now lists which materials CIG won't return on disassembly (6 ores: Quantainium, Stileron, Savrilium, Lindinium, Riccite, Ouratite; 2 entity classes: Saldynium, Janalite). Blacklisted slots are shown struck-through in the disassemble view.

⚒ Fabricator: recoil StatRows now use sign-magnitude comparison — CIG sometimes models recoil with negative pitch/yaw values; the signed lowerBetter check was painting -0.13 → -0.08 red even though it's a recoil reduction.

📥 Watcher Import dialog: shows the raw event payload alongside the resolved mission and disambiguates between multiple candidate matches when the debugName is ambiguous. Helps when an event lands on more than one possible mission.

🔗 Smart-link by GUID — ?g=<guid> now resolves automatically to either a mission detail or a blueprint detail in the Fabricator, whichever the GUID matches. Lets you share a single link without knowing the target type upfront.
📱 Performance: animated pulse effects switched from box-shadow to opacity keyframes — box-shadow is CPU-heavy at high frame rates; the visual is identical, the cost drops sharply.
👤 Profile: action buttons render boxy again — CSS class typo had stripped the box style on the export / clear buttons.

📦 Parser regenerations through the 1.0.13 cycle: scope displayName resolution, parentId on SubContracts, slot-level cargoManifest, ship cargoSCU + slot-cargo pre-filter, spawnChance / maxShips, detonationDamage on ammoPools, corrected ship classifications, hedged knownIssue notes, mission-history index.

🔧 Blueprint collection progress — tile cards and the table now show how many blueprints you already own out of each mission's pool (e.g. 3/8). Tile view gets a colored progress bar under the divider; table view shows a color-coded badge plus a separate gap (Δ) column. Both columns sortable.
🔧 Blueprint filter — new sidebar filter [All / Gaps / Done / Empty] lets you narrow missions by your collection state. Only visible when signed in.

🔧 Profile → BP-complete auto-mark — Tracking section now lists missions where you already own every blueprint from their pool but never explicitly accepted the mission. One click marks all of them as completed. Catches the common case where multiple missions share a single pool.

👤 Profile export: opt-in identity fields — checkboxes to include your display name, verified RSI handle, and/or organizations in the exported JSON. All off by default — anonymous export stays the default. Filename includes your handle when identifying fields are opted in. Schema bumped to v3.

📡 Log Watcher v0.1.7 — events now carry a channel field (LIVE / PTU / HOTFIX / EPTU). Frontend gates events strictly: LIVE/HOTFIX runs always apply to your tracking (even when the SCMDB UI is showing a different channel — watcher keeps recording in the background); PTU and other ephemeral channels never enter the DB because CIG wipes them on patch. Orange status badge + info banner explain the state.

📡 Log Watcher: SubContract resolution — missions with debug-name suffix variants (e.g. FTL_Courier_Stanton_TissueSamples_Rank1_1) now resolve directly to their merged parent via the new contractDefinitionIds[] and debugNames[] arrays. No more silent misses on missions that share a generator pool.

🌐 Mission detail: Available In section — Pyro and Stanton acceptance regions are now clickable chips that expand into a grouped location list (Planets / Stations / Lagrange / Asteroid Belts / Other). Previously the L-points and RAB locations were hidden by an over-aggressive filter.

🌐 Mission detail: Spawn Area fallback — when a mission has no specific location constraint, a new 'Spawn Area' section shows which systems it can spawn in instead of leaving the Requirements tab blank.

🌐 Mission badges: Cross-System missions now show the correct single-system badge when the parser determines the actual spawn systems (e.g. Stanton + Pyro routes show 'Multi'). The earlier Cross-System guess heuristic is replaced by the parser-derived availableSystems list.

📝 Mission descriptions: propertyValues — placeholders like [FUELRATE] and [APPROVAL_CODE] in descriptions are now replaced with the mission's actual values (e.g. "240 aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen"). Runtime tokens like [SHIP] and [LOCATION] stay as badges since they're spawn-time random.
⛏ Mining Solver: rock mass slider extended to 200k — in-game rocks of ~142k mass have been observed, the previous 100k cap left no headroom.

View-controls split into a horizontally-scrollable middle cluster and a pinned right cluster (settings gear, watcher, sign-in) so the essentials are always reachable on vertical 1080p/1200p monitors.
